summary: Contributed across full-stack feature engineering on an enterprise scholarship platform, alongside high-concurrency API load profiling and mobile client automation on a commercial restaurant management system.

tasks.title: Full-Stack Feature Engineering
tasks.description: Engineered core features for a production scholarship management platform, implementing role-based access control (RBAC) dashboards, analytical reporting views, and critical defect resolutions.

tasks.title: Backend API Performance & Load Profiling
tasks.description: Executed large-scale load and stress testing on the restaurant management backend to isolate API latency bottlenecks, profile throughput under peak traffic, and ensure concurrency stability.

tasks.title: Mobile App Automated Regression Suites
tasks.description: Engineered automated end-to-end regression test suites with Appium and WebdriverIO for the restaurant platform's mobile client, ensuring critical order flows and staff workflows remain regression-safe.
